correctness.rationale: Define the explicit two-rectangle lattice staircase S for each of six residue classes. Direct polynomial identities establish |S|=a and the three positive a-multiple reductions of its complement, with n>=48 ensuring ordered integer corners. gcd(a,b,c)=1 because a+c-2b=3 and a,b are not both divisible by 3. Every residue has a semigroup representation, all representations reduce strictly to S, |S|=a enforces uniqueness, and hence S is precisely Ap(H,a). Maximum at either staircase corner yields exact six cubic formulas after explicit sign checks. Independent integer Dijkstra Apéry replay and exact polynomial identity checks support computation; infinitude comes from the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: An existing natural and named numerical-semigroup sequence A069757 is given an infinite closed-form classification rather than a finite table. The complete Apéry staircase additionally determines each least residue representative, making exact computation of other semigroup invariants possible. This is a motivated extension beyond established square, cube and triangular triple families, not merely an arbitrary finite cutoff.
